verdict.rationale: Adyen docs confirm tipping is supported via terminal/POS app/receipt, and that a tip amount can be suggested by the POS app for the customer to accept, change, or decline on the terminal (adyen-pos-docs-26, adyen-pos-docs-30, adyen-pos-docs-9). However, the evidence never details merchant-ops-configurable smart-tip percentage tiers or custom-amount prompt configuration UI—only that tip amounts are set in the payment request. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of percentage-based smart tipping configuration, custom tip entry flows, and merchant-ops-facing configuration tools (vs. developer-set tip amounts).
